policies: What to bring Dress for the weather!
Items cancelled outside 72 hours are entitled to a full refund minus a 20% admin fee.
If the weather is inclement and the ship does not sail we will do our best to reschedule you.
Additional information Rain Date: Due to the unpredictable nature of fall weather, a rain date of October 10th has been set for this event.
Items cancelled outside 1 week are entitled to a full refund minus a 20% admin fee.
The captain will only cancel sails should the weather present a safety issue.
The reservations are NON-CANCELABLE AND NON-REFUNDABLE WITHIN 90 DAYS OF THE SAILING DATE.
